theme.title: Golden State's fourth
theme.subtitle: The 2022 Finals
theme.recap: The Warriors won a fourth title in eight years behind Stephen Curry and a 21–0 run in the clincher.

questions.prompt: With Golden State down 2–1 in the 2022 Finals, how many points did Stephen Curry score in Game 4?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Curry scored 43 points and had 10 rebounds in a 107–97 win to even the series 2–2.

questions.prompt: Steve Kerr's 2022 title was his ninth overall. How many did he win as a player?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Steve Kerr won his ninth championship overall, after winning five as a player.

questions.prompt: In the 2022 title clincher, Golden State went on an unanswered run of how many points?
questions.note: 21–0, the longest in modern Finals history.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 21–0 run was the longest such run in modern Finals history.

questions.prompt: Jayson Tatum set the record for turnovers in one postseason in 2022. How many?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Tatum set the NBA record for most turnovers in a single postseason with 100.
